'''Bantha patties''' were a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]] made from [[Bantha/Legends|banthas]],<ref name="Death Troopers" /> a species of [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]].<ref name="SoT">''[[Stay on Target]]''</ref> The patties were edible by [[Human/Legends|Humans]].<ref name="Death Troopers" /> In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]],<ref name="Essential">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the novel ''[[Death Troopers]] to [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].</ref> bantha patties were served in the mess hall aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. The ''Purge''{{'s}} [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]], [[Jareth Sartoris]], drank lukewarm [[Caf/Legends|caf]] and ate a reheated bantha patty that were offered in the mess hall.<ref name="Death Troopers" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bantha patties appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'' by [[Joe Schreiber]].<ref name="Death Troopers" />
